CustomField.description: The deal this checklist group belongs to. MASTER-DETAIL, not a lookup: access to a checklist is exactly access to its Transaction, which is what makes the 11 groups per deal visible to the deal team without a single sharing rule. A master-detail field is always required and always cascade-deletes, so required and deleteConstraint are deliberately absent - the Metadata API rejects both on this type. It is also NON-PERMISSIONABLE: it must never appear in a permission set fieldPermissions block or the deploy fails.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The deal this checklist belongs to. Set when the checklist is created and cannot be changed afterwards.
CustomField.label: Transaction
